abilities.name: eabz/tirith
abilities.description: 面向在同一代码仓库中协同工作的并行编程智能体的协调服务器。智能体在编辑前需声明认领文件或目录；发生冲突认领时会直接拒绝并返回所有者、原因及过期时间，或在服务端挂起等待，若智能体掉线租约将自动失效。认领操作还会返回这些路径的变更通知、带版本的接口契约、决策记录和路径作用域的记忆笔记，使智能体积累的经验无需重新检索即可无缝传递给下一个智能体。包含 22 个工具，覆盖认领、带依赖的任务看板、契约、通知、决策日志、记忆笔记和智能体消息。传输协议：stdio（`tirith stdio`）或位于 `http://127.0.0.1:7477/mcp` 的 Streamable HTTP，并在 `http://127.0.0.1:7477/` 提供实时仪表盘；本地后台守护进程，无鉴权、无遥测、无嵌入向量依赖。支持客户端：Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、LangGraph、CrewAI 或任意 MCP 客户端。安装：`cargo install tirith-mcp`（crate 名称 `tirith-mcp`，二进制文件 `tirith`），或通过 `curl -LsSf https://eabz.github.io/tirith/install.sh | sh` 获取 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的 x86_64 及 ARM64 预编译二进制文件。文档：https://eabz.github.io/tirith/。官方 MCP Registry ID：`io.github.eabz/tirith` (v1.1.1)。MIT 协议。

en.name: eabz/tirith
en.description: Coordination server for parallel coding agents working in one repository. An agent claims files or directories before editing; overlapping claims are refused with the owner, reason and expiry, or waited out server-side, and leases expire if the agent dies. The claim also returns the change notices, versioned interface contracts, decisions and path-scoped memory notes for those paths, so what one agent learned reaches the next one without a search. 22 tools across claims, a task board with dependencies, contracts, notices, a decisions log, memory notes and agent messages. Transport: stdio (`tirith stdio`) or Streamable HTTP at `http://127.0.0.1:7477/mcp`, with a live dashboard at `http://127.0.0.1:7477/`; local daemon, no auth, no telemetry, no embeddings. Clients: Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, LangGraph, CrewAI, or any MCP client. Install: `cargo install tirith-mcp` (crate `tirith-mcp`, binary `tirith`), or prebuilt macOS, Linux and Windows binaries for x86_64 and ARM64 via `curl -LsSf https://eabz.github.io/tirith/install.sh | sh`. Docs: https://eabz.github.io/tirith/. Official MCP Registry id `io.github.eabz/tirith` (v1.1.1). MIT.

en.name: Hyperresearch
en.description: Hosted deep-research service. Start research runs that produce cited reports, read the reports and their sources, search the workspace's source vault, and check a document's citations against its sources. Tools include `start_run`, `run_status`, `run_result`, `search_notes`, `read_note`, `list_projects` and `verify_citations`. Streamable HTTP at `https://mcp.hyperresearch.ai/mcp`, nothing to install. Auth: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration, or `Authorization: Bearer hr_live_...` with an API key that has the `mcp` scope. Research runs are billed per run. Registry id `ai.hyperresearch/hyperresearch`. Open-source CLI: [jordan-gibbs/hyperresearch](https://github.com/jordan-gibbs/hyperresearch).

en.name: Hypnothera
en.description: Official MCP server for personalized guided hypnosis audio. Lets an agent search a free library of ready-made sessions by topic, create a personalized session or a 2–30 day journey from a short brief the user approves first (chat logs are never sent), continue journeys day by day, list narrator voices and render audio in the chosen voice. Remote Streamable HTTP server at `https://hypnothera.ai/api/mcp` with OAuth 2.1 (dynamic client registration, PKCE). Tools: `get_account`, `list_topics`, `search_sessions`, `get_session`, `list_voices`, `list_journeys`, `create_session`, `continue_journey`, `render_audio`. abilities.name: Ifeanyiejindu/qarunbook
abilities.description: 支持 Agent 与人工测试团队协同工作的共享 UAT（用户验收测试）运行手册 —— 导入 Markdown 格式的测试计划、读取失败项、按平台（Web、iOS、Android）记录测试通过/失败并附带截图，以及使用测试人员原话提交或解决 Issue。检查状态采用动态推导而非静态存储，标记为已修复的 Issue 会将对应检查项重新打回复测，而非直接置为通过。包含 14 个工具，如 `list_apps`、`progress`、`list_checks`、`list_issues`、`get_check`、`import_plan`、`set_result`、`add_issue` 和 `resolve_issue`。远程服务器架构，传输方式为 `streamable-http`，采用 Bearer Token 鉴权（握手及 `tools/list` 接口无需 Token）；兼容 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Cursor 和 Codex。安装命令：`claude mcp add qa-runbook --transport http https://qarunbook.com/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>"`。文档：https://qarunbook.com/guides/qa-mcp-server。MIT 协议。

zh.name: Ifeanyiejindu/qarunbook
zh.description: 支持 Agent 与人工测试团队协同工作的共享 UAT（用户验收测试）运行手册 —— 导入 Markdown 格式的测试计划、读取失败项、按平台（Web、iOS、Android）记录测试通过/失败并附带截图，以及使用测试人员原话提交或解决 Issue。检查状态采用动态推导而非静态存储，标记为已修复的 Issue 会将对应检查项重新打回复测，而非直接置为通过。包含 14 个工具，如 `list_apps`、`progress`、`list_checks`、`list_issues`、`get_check`、`import_plan`、`set_result`、`add_issue` 和 `resolve_issue`。远程服务器架构，传输方式为 `streamable-http`，采用 Bearer Token 鉴权（握手及 `tools/list` 接口无需 Token）；兼容 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Cursor 和 Codex。安装命令：`claude mcp add qa-runbook --transport http https://qarunbook.com/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>"`。文档：https://qarunbook.com/guides/qa-mcp-server。MIT 协议。

en.name: Ifeanyiejindu/qarunbook
en.description: Shared user-acceptance-testing runbook an agent and a human test team work from together — import a markdown test plan, read what is failing, record a pass or fail per platform (web, iOS, Android) with screenshots, and raise or resolve issues in testers' own words. Check status is derived rather than stored, so an issue marked fixed sends the check back for a retest instead of passing it. 14 tools including `list_apps`, `progress`, `list_checks`, `list_issues`, `get_check`, `import_plan`, `set_result`, `add_issue` and `resolve_issue`. Remote server, transport `streamable-http`, bearer-token auth (handshake and `tools/list` answer without a token); works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and Codex. Install: `claude mcp add qa-runbook --transport http https://qarunbook.com/api/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>"`. Docs: https://qarunbook.com/guides/qa-mcp-server. MIT.

abilities.name: ilyautov/moysklad-mcp-ru
abilities.description: 专为 AI Agent 打造的 MoySklad（俄罗斯广泛使用的贸易管理与库存服务）集成工具：支持库存、商品、订单、交易对手、门店、利润/营业额/现金报表以及单据写入。内置官方 JSON API 1.2 文档中的 892 个方法并以目录形式由服务端执行，通过 8 个通用元工具（`ms_search_methods`、`ms_describe_method`、`ms_call_method`、`ms_call_raw`、`ms_fetch_all`、`ms_map` 及账户管理工具）搭配类型化读取工具进行调用，客户端只需极少工具槽位而非 892 个 Schema。所有方法均标注为读取/写入/破坏性操作：读取立即执行，创建单据需 `confirm_write=true` 且 `MOYSKLAD_ALLOW_WRITE=1`，过账或删除还需 `i_understand_this_modifies_data=true`；创建操作始终生成草稿，过账为独立步骤，并通过 CI 测试确保无写操作被误标为读取。支持 7 种单据角色类型（采购订单、入库、出库、采购发票、销售发票、销售退货、采购退货）。API 金额单位为戈比，读取工具会自动转换为卢布。支持自动分页、多账户管理与俄语目录搜索。安装：`uvx moysklad-mcp-ru`；stdio 传输；Token 从 MoySklad“设置 -> 用户 -> 访问令牌”获取，保存在本地 `~/.moysklad-mcp/cabinets.json`（chmod 600）。客户端：Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode。方法映射与设置：https://moysklad-mcp-ru.aifrontier.tech/。官方 MCP 注册表 ID：`io.github.ilyautov/moysklad-mcp-ru`。Alpha 状态：核心功能与写入部分已通过实盘验证，其余目录从文档导入。开源协议：MIT。

en.name: ilyautov/moysklad-mcp-ru
en.description: MoySklad, a widely used Russian trade-management and inventory service, for AI agents: stock, products, orders, counterparties, stores, profit/turnover/cash reports, and document writes. 892 methods from the official JSON API 1.2 docs ship as a catalog the server executes, reached through 8 generic meta-tools (`ms_search_methods`, `ms_describe_method`, `ms_call_method`, `ms_call_raw`, `ms_fetch_all`, `ms_map` plus cabinet tools) alongside typed read tools, so a client sees tool slots instead of 892 schemas. Every method is classified read / write / destructive: reads run immediately, creating a document needs `confirm_write=true` and `MOYSKLAD_ALLOW_WRITE=1`, and posting or deleting additionally needs `i_understand_this_modifies_data=true`; creating always produces a draft and posting is a separate step, enforced by a CI test that no mutation is labelled read. 7 document role types (purchaseorder, supply, demand, invoicein, invoiceout, salesreturn, purchasereturn). API amounts are in kopecks and read tools convert to rubles. Auto-pagination, multiple cabinets, Russian-language catalog search. Install: `uvx moysklad-mcp-ru`; stdio; token from MoySklad Settings -> Users -> Access tokens, stored locally at `~/.moysklad-mcp/cabinets.json` (chmod 600). Clients: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode. Method map and setup: https://moysklad-mcp-ru.aifrontier.tech/ . Official MCP Registry id `io.github.ilyautov/moysklad-mcp-ru`. Alpha: the curated core and the write slice are verified against a live cabinet, the rest of the catalog is imported from the docs. MIT.
